title: haex-hive Molecule Manifest v3
description: Schema for a per-molecule manifest.json. Delivered files are grouped by category in atoms; a molecule is not a composition list.

id.description: Reverse-DNS molecule-id. Must equal the publisher-root-manifest key that referenced this molecule.

version.description: Semver X.Y.Z. Must equal the version the publisher root manifest declared for this molecule-id.

priority.description: Publisher's default priority. Consumer configuration may override it.

atoms.description: Category names mapped to non-empty lists of molecule-directory-relative delivered files.

defaults.description: Default values for the molecule's config_schema.

config_schema.description: Path (molecule-directory-relative) to the molecule's config JSON Schema.
